clue.text: Nick has spirit

definitions.meaning: to nick or ... is to cut a notch or score in something
Whisky distilled in Scotland, a spirit

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a scotch is a shallow cut or nick, and Scotch whisky is a distilled spirit.

clue.text: Take the air and rally

definitions.meaning: taking air into the lungs is breathing in
to rally troops is to rouse and encourage them

explanation.definitionFit: To breathe in is the literal sense of the word, and its figurative sense is to rouse or encourage others.

clue.text: Listeria hysteria, for instance, leads to culinary hygiene

definitions.text: Listeria hysteria, for instance, leads to culinary hygiene

parts.words: Listeria hysteria, for instance, leads to culinary hygiene
parts.note: public panic over a bacterial contamination of meals makes kitchens clean up their act

explanation.surface: A panic over listeria bacteria prompts a clean-up of kitchen practices.
explanation.definitionFit: A public panic about contaminated produce, such as the listeria scares of the late 1980s, is the kind of event the phrase names.

clue.text: Indignation about apprentice linesman

indicators.note: the word for indignation is placed around the learner's letter

parts.note: indignation is anger
L is for learner, an apprentice, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A trainee line judge provokes outrage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Linesman' looks like a football official, but it means someone who fishes with a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A fisherman casts a line, so someone fishing with rod and line is jokingly a man of the line.

clue.text: Temporary lodgings given to you and me in college grounds

parts.note: a camp is a set of temporary lodgings such as tents
you and me together are us

explanation.surface: Students set up tents on the university lawns for the two of us.
explanation.definitionFit: The grounds and buildings of a university or college are its site, known by this Latin-derived word.

clue.text: Church with a popular proverb has the cutting edge

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a saw is an old saying or proverb

explanation.surface: A church whose favourite saying makes it seem ahead of the times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Has the cutting edge' suggests being modern; the definition is a tool that literally has a cutting edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A motor-driven saw with teeth on a moving loop is a tool all about its cutting blade.

clue.text: Soft-hearted fellow is a syrup manufacturer

indicators.note: with soft at its heart, so the letter for soft goes into the middle of the word for fellow

parts.note: a fellow is a male
P is piano, the musical direction for soft

explanation.surface: A tender-hearted man turns out to make syrup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soft-hearted' reads as kind, but it means the soft letter P is put in the heart of MALE.
explanation.definitionFit: The sugar maple's sap is boiled down to make a sweet syrup, so the tree produces it.

clue.text: No tulips artificially made can be natural

indicators.note: something artificially made is fashioned anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fake tulips can never look like the real thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Untouched and unspoiled, something in its original natural state is pristine.

clue.text: Dash! The fraud squad has clearly had success

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of annoyance, like 'blast!' or 'damn!'

definitions.text: The fraud squad has clearly had success
definitions.meaning: detectives hunting a swindle (a con) have located it

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a mild oath like 'blast it!', and split into two it describes a swindle that has been discovered.

clue.text: Is no longer smug, quiet and petulant

parts.note: what is no longer is in the past: was
PI, short for pious, means sanctimonious or smug
SH is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone who used to be self-satisfied is now merely sulky.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritable and spiteful in manner, as if ready to sting like an insect, is to be peevish.

clue.text: Recorded and copied to a T

definitions.meaning: recorded on a tape, as a broadcast or a voice
copied exactly, as a recording on tape duplicates sound perfectly

explanation.definitionFit: Recording on magnetic tape captures a performance, and a recording reproduces it exactly.

clue.text: Calm course where note never varied

definitions.meaning: the idiom 'the ... of one's way' means a calm, steady progress
a level singing voice of the higher male range, its note kept steady

explanation.definitionFit: Tenor once meant a settled course, so an unbroken one is calm, and a male singing part held level never varies.

clue.text: Someone stock-holders would be wise to appraise

definitions.text: Someone stock-holders would be wise to appraise

parts.words: Someone stock-holders would be wise to appraise
parts.note: stock-holders here are farmers keeping livestock, who should call in an animal doctor; the word also means to appraise

explanation.surface: Shareholders ought to check out the person they invest with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stock-holders' suggests investors, but it means livestock farmers; the word also means to check or appraise, as one vets a candidate.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal doctor treats livestock, and to examine someone carefully is to check them over.

clue.text: Solid foundation of committed party members

definitions.meaning: broken brick and stone used as a base layer under roads and floors
the most dedicated, uncompromising supporters of a movement

explanation.definitionFit: Builders lay rubble as a firm base, and the most devoted loyalists of a party are its inner nucleus.

clue.text: US lunar spacecraft needing solar power

definitions.meaning: the NASA programme that put astronauts on the moon
the Greek god of the sun, a solar deity

explanation.definitionFit: The NASA moon missions bore the name of the Greek sun god, a divine power linked with the sun.

clue.text: Fairies manage to get an overall view with it

definitions.text: get an overall view with it

parts.note: peris are fairies or sprites in Persian mythology
to cope is to manage

explanation.surface: Fairies manage to get a broad view of things.
explanation.definitionFit: A submarine's tube of mirrors lets the crew see the whole surface scene from below.

clue.text: Sanction law about cider production

indicators.note: the word for a law goes round the rearranged cider

parts.note: an act is a law passed by parliament

indicators.note: the cider letters are produced in a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Legislators approve a law governing how cider is made.
explanation.definitionFit: To authorise or officially approve something is to give it official recognition.

clue.text: Manage to upset railway employees

indicators.note: upset means overturned, so in this down-and-across grid the union's letters are read backwards

parts.note: NUR was the National Union of Railwaymen, a British trade union

explanation.surface: Trying to provoke workers on the railway.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUR was the National Union of Railwaymen in Britain; 'upset' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate or be in charge of a business is to direct it.

clue.text: Without knowledge of European articles and merchandise

parts.note: UN is the French indefinite article and A the English one
wares are goods for sale

explanation.surface: Ignorant of continental items and goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Being caught off guard means acting with no prior knowledge or warning.

clue.text: Element of law enforcement occasions dread

indicators.note: an element of the phrase is a part of it, so the letters sit inside those words

explanation.surface: A part of policing sometimes inspires fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverential fear mixed with wonder is a feeling of fearful respect.

clue.text: A copper with humanity and discernment

parts.note: CU is the chemical symbol for copper
men stands for humankind, humanity in general

explanation.surface: A humane police officer with good judgement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a police officer; it is the metal, symbol CU.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrewdness and keen insight are the qualities of good judgement.

clue.text: Pitch must be reserved

definitions.meaning: to pitch is to throw
reserved means timid and bashful

explanation.definitionFit: To throw something is one sense, and a bashful, retiring person is the other.

clue.text: Reasonable record by one accountant over fifty

parts.note: a log is a written record, as of a voyage
I is the Roman numeral for one
CA is a chartered accountant
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A sensible entry in the books from an accountant aged over fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' places CA above L in this down answer; CA is a chartered accountant.
explanation.definitionFit: Following sound reasoning makes a conclusion sensible and rational.

clue.text: Got on with the batting?

parts.note: a cricketer who struck the ball hard, read as people who became friendly

explanation.surface: A question about whether the batsmen made good progress.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom means became friendly; the question mark points to the cricket sense of striking the ball away.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people who become friendly at once are said to strike up a good relationship, and a batsman literally strikes the ball.

clue.text: Jacob writes review of serial

indicators.note: a review revisits and recasts the word serial, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A writer named Jacob critiques a television serial.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis Jacob is renamed after wrestling with an angel, and the name became that of his people and the modern nation.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible the patriarch Jacob was given a new name, later the name of the Jewish nation.

clue.text: Common man in the timber trade

definitions.meaning: an informal, colloquial word for a fellow or chap
one who cuts down trees for lumber

explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially a chap or fellow, and literally a lumberjack who cuts down trees.

clue.text: Angered by methods not on the level

parts.note: cross means annoyed or angered
ways are methods

explanation.surface: Angry at dishonest practices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not on the level' suggests dishonesty, but it means set at a slant, across rather than straight.
explanation.definitionFit: Placed diagonally or athwart, something lies across rather than straight and level.

clue.text: Uncivil attempt to embrace the queen

indicators.note: the word for attempt embraces, or wraps around, the queen's letter

parts.note: a shot is an attempt
R is for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A rude attempt to hug the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: R stands for Regina, the queen, as in royal cyphers.
explanation.definitionFit: Being curt and abrupt in speech is being rude or impolite.

clue.text: About to rise, despite the cold

parts.note: C is circa, Latin for about
a hill is a rise in the ground

explanation.surface: Someone about to get up in spite of the cold weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to rise' reads as about to get up; it is C (circa) followed by HILL, a rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold feeling or a slight coolness in the air is a nip.

clue.text: Postpone giving our number to a disc jockey

parts.note: N is the mathematical symbol for a number

explanation.surface: Delaying by handing our song request to the radio presenter.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspend a meeting until a later time is to defer it.

clue.text: Reminder not to open the rice-wine

parts.note: to keep a bottle is to hold on to it rather than open it
sake is Japanese rice wine

explanation.surface: A note telling someone to save the Japanese rice wine for later.
explanation.definitionFit: A memento kept to recall a person or occasion serves as a souvenir.

clue.text: Conditions necessary for a federation

definitions.meaning: situations or circumstances one is in
a federal union is made up of member regions such as those of the US

explanation.definitionFit: Situations and conditions are one sense, and the member regions that join to form a federal nation are the other.
